note: G2 wiring template for the real-agent pilot. Preparing this config authorizes NOTHING: every field marked OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED must be decided by the Owner before any real model runs (SPEC v0.3 §9.2/§10 PR-02; task instruction §5 exit conditions). The actor wiring itself now EXISTS and is rehearsed offline (lib/actor.mjs + lib/real-runner.mjs + scripts/__tests__/principle-learning-lab-actor.test.ts, deterministic fake transports only).

perArm: isolated agent profile (own memory dir, own config)
no shared cache across arms; the stub tests prove no cross-contamination

actorWiring.transport: createPiAdapterTransport({ adapter }) in lib/actor.mjs — wraps the PRODUCTION PiAiRuntimeAdapter (startRun/fetchOutput boundary, outputSchemaRef 'learning-lab-actor-action-v1' registered in OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REGISTRY)
actorWiring.interactiveLoop: runRealActorOpportunity() — one model round per oracle action, observation-reactive, hard caps enforced
actorWiring.capsTemplate: DEFAULT_REAL_ACTOR_CAPS (lib/actor.mjs): maxStepsPerOpportunity=40, maxRequestsPerOpportunity=16, maxInvalidActions=2, maxTokensPerRequest=512, timeoutMsPerRequest=60s, totalBudgetMsPerOpportunity=300s — real-run values frozen at OD-2
actorWiring.offlineRehearsal: scripts/__tests__/principle-learning-lab-actor.test.ts (18 tests: reactivity, terminal stop, bounded invalid, caps, NT-01 channel guard, cross-arm isolation, freeze integrity, sidecar validity, study-stop-on-leak)

arms.generation: I0 reflection OR I1 pipeline (frozen real output)

cAContrastArms.note: Same channel, same position, same budget; only the CONTENT differs.
conditions: high-quality ordinary memory summary (must be honestly strong — no weak strawman)

budgets.model: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED — provider, model id, per-run cost ceiling, stop threshold

httpRequests.note: P1-01: real outbound HTTP requests are enforced by a fail-closed ledger at the fetch boundary (opportunity -> arm -> study). Offline defaults are record-keeping for fake transports and are NEVER a cost authorization.

gatesBeforeRealRuns: stub wiring + isolation tests green (principle-learning-lab test suite)
real-actor offline rehearsal suite green (principle-learning-lab-actor test suite) — DONE 2026-10-18, 18/18
model credentials and cost ceiling decided (OD-2)
exitConditions: credentials missing or cost ceiling undecided -> mark NOT_RUN, do not execute
isolation or contamination check fails -> stop, record, do not proceed
judge-only information leak detected -> stop, record INVALID_PROTOCOL

realRunAuthorizationContract.gate: createAuthorizedPiTransport (lib/actor.mjs) runs verifyRealRunAuthorization BEFORE any transport/adapter exists — failure means zero HTTP requests can occur (fail-closed).

od1.requirement: preregistration.status must be exactly OWNER_APPROVED (DRAFT_NOT_OWNER_APPROVED can never authorize), plus authorization.od1 {approved: literal true, decisionRef, frozenFixtureHash == dataset.fixtureHash}

od2.requirement: authorization.od2 {provider, model, apiKeyEnv, baseUrl?, credentialsAvailable: literal true, perRunCostCapUsd, totalCostCapUsd, costBasisRef (official billing evidence), httpRequestsPerOpportunity/PerArm/PerStudy, stopCondition} — all explicit; offline defaults are not honored

realRunAuthorizationContract.consistencyChecks: provider/model/apiKeyEnv/baseUrl and the three HTTP caps in the runtime call must equal the authorized values — any drift refuses before the first request
realRunAuthorizationContract.telemetryAttribution: retry (llm_max_tokens_downshift) and repair (output_repair_attempted) counts are aggregated from adapter telemetry per arm; per-HTTP-attempt token usage comes from the ledger (null/unavailable when the provider stream carries none)
